services.name: River Kids - Camp
services.desc: This summer learn one of the hottest new sports in the world; Stand Up Paddle. About Learn new sports on the river this summer while making lifelong memories and friends with Oceanport Paddle Club River Kids Camp! River Kids is an extended group instruction program. It includes Stand Up Paddle, kayaking instruction. Stand Up Paddle Boarding (SUP) is an offshoot of surfing that originated in Hawaii. Unlike traditional surfing where the rider sits until a wave comes, stand up paddle boarders stand on their boards and use a paddle to propel themselves through the water. OPC River Kids runs for 3 Ages 7+ • 3 Days • Oceanport Location

services.name: River Kid’s - Single Sessions (Oceanport Location)
services.desc: River Kids - Single Session can be used as supplemental instruction or for the child who wants to get a taste of paddle sports in a fun supervised and safe way. This is for the Oceanport location only. About River Kid’s - Single Sessions is an extended group instruction program. It includes Stand Up Paddle, kayaking instruction and land activities. Experience is preferred but not necessary. River Kid’s Mini Camp - Single Sessions runs for 3 hours. These are single sessions and multiple dates can be reserved. This extended group instruction will book fast! With over 25 years combined SUP Oceanport Location • 3 Hours

services.name: OPC After School
services.desc: Back to school can be a difficult transition for many families, but even more challenging is establishing a routine for getting homework done. What better way than in small groups led by certified teachers followed by some water fun? This is for the Oceanport location only. 2 Hours About Certified teachers will help students with organization, specifically mapping out assignments that are of higher priority based on due dates while also breaking down long-term projects into more manageable chunks. Students will be given “brain breaks” and the opportunity to participate in Stand Up Oceanport Location • 2 Hours

services.name: Full Moon Paddle
services.desc: Nights at Oceanport Paddle Club 🌕✨ Paddle. Chill. Repeat. ✨🌕 Join us each month as we celebrate the magic of the full moon with a relaxed, scenic paddle session along the calm waters near the OPC docks. Whether you’re on the water or hanging out on land, everyone is welcome at our Full Moon Paddles—paddlers and non-paddlers alike! No paddle? No problem. Even if you’re not paddling, you’re encouraged to come by! Head up to OPC HQ, grab a seat, BYOB, and enjoy the river views, good vibes, and our famous Full Moon Playlist. It’s totally free to hang out—bring your friends and 4 available dates • 1 Hour paddle (hangout afterwards)

services.name: Creek Pro – Paddle Leadership Experience
services.desc: Stand up. Paddle strong. Lead forward. About Formerly known as Elite Paddle Camp Creek Pro is not your average summer program. Designed for teens ages 12–18, this immersive 2.5-hour session runs Tuesday through Thursday and offers a dynamic blend of high-level Stand Up Paddleboarding (SUP), personal growth, and leadership training. Several past participants have even gone on to join our staff, turning their passion into purpose. Participants will be challenged mentally and physically through structured paddle sessions aimed at pushing their limits—on the water and within themselves. They’ll Tuesday - Thursday 1-3:30 • 3 Days • Oceanport Location • Ages 10+

services.name: Mindfulness on the Tides
services.desc: 1 Hour and 15 Minutes About Stand Up Paddleboard therapy is a form of experiential therapy. This holistically-based experience will engage aspects of the client's physical and mental health. Elements from nature may be used symbolically in session as clients connect with and reap the healing benefits of the wind and water. Chelsea is eager to provide an opportunity to encourage mindfulness as clients become attuned with nature. In this non-traditional form of therapy, individuals are able to respond to their surroundings and engage in self-exploration in a unique way. Paddleboarding 1 Hour and 15 Min • Oceanport Location • Group Mindfulness Session • On Paddleboards
